change_summary: accepted_measurement_repair: never-claimed promotion-lane reservations are no longer deadlocked. New narrow predicate _is_never_claimed_duplicate_accounting_close in scripts/experiment_registry.py lets a proposed, never-claimed, receipt-less ticket close only as rejected + realized_failure_mode=duplicate_reservation_accounting, skipping receipt requirement and promotion re-validation for that bookkeeping close alone. 4 new boundary tests; quant/test_experiment_registry.py 65/65. Applied live: exp-20260804-002 (10-day backlog) and exp-20260814-001 both closed.
component: scripts/experiment_registry.py, tests, data/experiments, experiments/tickets, experiments/cards, experiments/logs, experiments/manifests
hypothesis: Never-claimed promotion-lane experiment reservations are deadlocked by the claim-receipt closeout guard: a reservation whose claim fails during claim-receipt construction (for example the receipt CAS per-file size cap) can neither be claimed nor closed, because every closeout path requires an alpha_promotion_claim_receipt that only a successful claim can produce. Second occurrence (exp-20260804-002 documented backlog, exp-20260814-001 today). Repair: permit closing a ticket that was never claimed (claimed_at null, no claim receipt, status proposed) only as non-substantive duplicate_reservation_accounting bookkeeping with a rejected-flavored terminal status, keeping every substantive closeout receipt-gated.
notes: Root causes preserved: substantive closes still require receipts; the 64MB receipt CAS cap contract is unchanged (large warehouse surfaces must bind compact identity manifests, as the v3 bundle now does).

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not widen the bypass predicate (no claimed tickets, no observed_only/accepted flavors, no non-duplicate failure modes); do not re-litigate the receipt CAS 64MB cap by binding raw multi-GB stores again.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A third deadlock shape that the never-claimed predicate cannot express (e.g. claim partially persisted claimed_at before receipt failure) would justify reopening this contract; otherwise none.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Deterministic tooling defect; repair behaved as predicted on both live deadlocked tickets.

prediction.confidence_reason: Deterministic tooling defect with reproducible deadlock; narrow predicate keeps the anti-bypass property; risk is mostly in status-string conventions consumed by audit/family builders.
